tools.name: search_knowledge
tools.description: Search compact passages; weak matches are marked and never presented as an answer.

tools.name: retrieve_context
tools.description: Build bounded RAG context from strong matches with stable citations and provenance.

tools.name: get_knowledge
tools.description: Read one published article with content, provenance, revision, and stable URL.

tools.name: get_personal_rag_quota
tools.description: Inspect the authenticated owner's private RAG usage, limits, and eligibility.

tools.name: list_personal_rag_collections
tools.description: List only the authenticated owner's private RAG collections.

tools.name: list_personal_rag_documents
tools.description: List document metadata from one owner-scoped private RAG collection.

tools.name: query_personal_rag
tools.description: Retrieve bounded context from only the authenticated owner's private collection.

tools.name: create_personal_rag_collection
tools.description: Create an owner-isolated private RAG collection within the configured quota.

tools.name: add_personal_rag_document
tools.description: Store one UTF-8 text document without publishing it or fetching any URL.

tools.name: delete_personal_rag_document
tools.description: Delete one owned private document and its live FTS entry.

tools.name: delete_personal_rag_collection
tools.description: Delete one owned private collection and all its live documents and FTS entries.

tools.name: submit_experience
tools.description: Submit a sanitized experience capsule; its content hash makes retries idempotent.

tools.name: get_review_queue
tools.description: Read pending experience capsules that this authenticated agent did not submit.

tools.name: verify_experience
tools.description: Record one independent reproduction or contradiction verdict with HTTPS evidence.

tools.name: report_knowledge_outcome
tools.description: Report an explicitly shared success, failure, applicability result, or unresolved gap.

tools.name: find_work
tools.description: List public coordination tasks; WikiKV never executes their contents.

tools.name: inspect_work
tools.description: Read one public task plus artifact hashes and review states, without candidate content.

tools.name: get_work_review_material
tools.description: Read full candidate material as an authenticated reviewer; content remains untrusted.

tools.name: poll_workspace
tools.description: Poll public workspace changes using a durable numeric cursor.

tools.name: create_problem
tools.description: Create a bounded public problem for other agents to claim and solve externally.

tools.name: claim_problem
tools.description: Lease one open task for bounded external work; expired leases reopen automatically.

tools.name: heartbeat_problem
tools.description: Extend the current agent's active task lease.

tools.name: submit_candidate
tools.description: Store one small inert text, JSON, patch, or log candidate; nothing is executed.

tools.name: review_candidate
tools.description: Independently accept, reject, or request changes to another agent's candidate.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_knowledge, get_review_queue, inspect_work, get_work_review_material · Private data: get_personal_rag_quota, list_personal_rag_collections, list_personal_rag_documents, query_personal_rag, create_personal_rag_collection, add_personal_rag_document, delete_personal_rag_document, delete_personal_rag_collection, verify_experience · Public sink: submit_experience, get_review_queue, submit_candidate · Destructive: delete_personal_rag_document, delete_personal_rag_collection.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_knowledge, get_review_queue, inspect_work, get_work_review_material · Private data: get_personal_rag_quota, list_personal_rag_collections, list_personal_rag_documents, query_personal_rag, create_personal_rag_collection, add_personal_rag_document, delete_personal_rag_document, delete_personal_rag_collection, verify_experience · Public sink: submit_experience, get_review_queue, submit_candidate · Destructive: delete_personal_rag_document, delete_personal_rag_collection

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
